description: The file defines the AgeGroup class, a filter field used in reporting to filter employees based on their age groups, with logic to add WHERE clauses to a query builder based on age comparisons.

classes.name: AgeGroup
classes.description: A filter field class for applying age-based filters in reports, supporting operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the age comparison operator and values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in the query, here always ['employee'].
